title: CIA sends Mooney's Cherokee book and asks about Native American DNA

tellings.quote: a book showed up to my house that uh was sent from some folks in the government CIA and said, "Read this."

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man whose experiences with UFOs have drawn interest, says a book arrived at his home in North Carolina, sent by "some folks in the government, CIA," with a note that said "Read this." The book was Myths of the Cherokee, written by James Mooney and published in 1891, and in this story the same people also asked him about Native American DNA. Bledsoe tells Michels this as something that happened to him, and it would suggest that people in government think his experiences connect to old Native American stories, and maybe to his family line.
